cr_data.provenance:
1953, consigned by the artist to The Downtown Gallery, New York (stock no. 183); September 16, 1957, sold by the Downtown Gallery to William H. Lane (b. 1914 - d. 1995), Leominster, MA [see note 1]; 1961, transferred to the William H. Lane Foundation; 1990, gift of the William H. Lane Foundation to the MFA.  (Accession Date: September 18, 1990) 
 
NOTES: 
[1] Archives of American Art, Downtown Gallery Records, Series 4, Business Records: Sales Slips (2 of 3), 1957: Reel 5628 (Box 73), Frame 1024. 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)

credit_line: Gift of the William H. Lane Foundation
description: A square black door sits at the center of a smooth, adobe wall. On the right side of the composition is a larger, rectangular wall supported by two wooden beams. Light brown earth stretches below the structure. Overhead, a strip of gray sky stretches across the length of the canvas.
title: In the Patio IV
